meta.title: AG Charts: High-Performance Angular Charts Library
meta.description: Build interactive, high-performance Angular charts with AG Charts. 30+ chart types, financial charts, maps, and more. Free to use with enterprise features available.

sections.heading: Fast, Interactive Angular Charts
sections.subHeadingHtml: Build high-performance, interactive, and beautiful Angular charts with AG Charts. From simple bar charts to complex financial charts, all for free.

sections.heading: 30+ Chart Types for Every Use Case
sections.subHeading: From simple bar and line charts to advanced financial charts, maps, gauges, and more. AG Charts has the chart type you need.

sections.heading: See What's Possible
sections.subHeading: Explore our gallery of examples to see the full range of charts you can build with AG Charts.

sections.heading: Interactive Charts
sections.subHeading: Experience the interactivity of AG Charts. Zoom, pan, and explore the data with tooltips and crosshairs.

sections.subHeadingHtml: AG Charts powers data visualization in applications across Fortune 500 companies, startups, and everything in between. Join thousands of developers building with AG Charts.

sections.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
sections.subHeading: Answers to common questions about building Angular charts with AG Charts

items.question: Is AG Charts free to use?
items.answer: Yes! AG Charts Community is free and open-source, with no restrictions on usage. [AG Charts Enterprise](/license-pricing/) offers additional features like financial charts, annotations, and advanced interactivity.

items.question: What chart types does AG Charts support?
items.answer: AG Charts supports 30+ chart types including Bar, Line, Area, Scatter, Pie, Donut, Radar, Treemap, Sunburst, Heatmap, Candlestick, Maps, Gauges, and many more. View all chart types in our [Gallery](/gallery/).

items.question: Can I use AG Charts with TypeScript?
items.answer: Yes! AG Charts is written in TypeScript and provides full type definitions. Our Angular integration works seamlessly with Angular's strict type checking.

items.question: How do I get started with AG Charts in Angular?
items.answer: Install the package with `npm install ag-charts-angular`, import the `AgCharts` component in your module, and use it in your template. See our [Quick Start guide](./angular/quick-start/) for a complete walkthrough.

items.question: What Angular versions are supported?
items.answer: AG Charts supports Angular 14 and later. We test against the latest Angular versions and maintain backwards compatibility.

items.question: What is AG Charts Enterprise?
items.answer: [AG Charts Enterprise](/license-pricing/) includes advanced features like Financial Charts with annotations, Maps, Gauges, Zoom, Crosshairs, and more. Try it free with a trial license.

items.question: Can AG Charts handle large datasets?
items.answer: Yes! AG Charts is optimized for performance and can handle millions of data points smoothly. Our canvas-based rendering ensures fast updates and smooth interactions.

items.question: Is AG Charts compatible with AG Grid?
items.answer: Yes! AG Charts integrates seamlessly with [AG Grid](https://www.ag-grid.com/) for Integrated Charts, allowing users to create charts directly from grid data.
